public_rationale: The difficulty component is supported by documented hallucination and mitigation problems. Surveys also show substantial experimentation, but they count organizations or executives rather than LLM deployment efforts. Their results cannot establish that most work remained preliminary by March 16. The combined claim therefore remains unresolved.
limitations: Partial support for deployment difficulty does not settle the majority claim.
Successful individual deployments can coexist with most projects remaining preliminary.
Survey scope, timing and sampling limit generalization.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Putting LLMs into production is hard and most deployment work to date has been preliminary.

statement.excerpt: But putting LLMs into production is hard; most work to date has been preliminary.

from_speaker: putting LLMs into production is hard
most work to date has been preliminary
our_interpretation: 'To date' and the birthday context describe cumulative deployment work during GPT-4's first year, ending at publication.
The plain reading of 'hard' is recurring material engineering or organizational barriers to dependable production use.
'Most' means more than half of LLM deployment efforts; 'preliminary' means experiments, proofs of concept or pilots.
The share of companies with any production deployment is not the share of projects in production.
criteria.support_condition: Engineering evidence documents recurring production barriers, and reasonably representative evidence shows more than half of LLM deployment efforts remained preliminary.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative project-level evidence shows that most LLM deployment efforts had reached routine production, or credible broad evidence shows that production deployment generally lacked material barriers.

evidence.explanation: The review documents hallucinations and the limitations of mitigation methods as obstacles to practical LLM use. It supports the difficulty component, but supplies no project-level production share.

evidence.excerpt: only used LLM for experimentation purposes.
evidence.locator: Opening discussion of Predibase's Beyond the Buzz survey
evidence.explanation: Reporting on 150 respondents surveyed from May through July says 44% described experimentation only and 13% reported at least one production LLM. This counts organizations, not deployment efforts, and is secondary reporting because the primary report was inaccessible.

evidence.locator: But Many Companies Are Falling Behind, paragraph beginning 'In short'
evidence.explanation: The categories combine leaders expecting AI to take time to move beyond hype with leaders pursuing limited experiments and pilots. This broader AI and GenAI survey counts leaders, overlaps categories and does not establish the share of LLM projects in production; its surrounding references to 'next year' place the responses in 2023 without precise field dates.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A representative survey or project inventory covering the target period, identifying LLM projects and classifying each as experimental, pilot or routine production, alongside documented deployment barriers.
